extracted.intended_audience: accredited journalists and media professionals; press representatives covering cardiovascular science and ESC events
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural expectations for journalists and media representatives who want to access, receive, and cover ESC press releases, embargoed content, congresses, and related resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accredited community membership
rubrics_metrics.description: Join our community of accredited journalists and media professionals to receive timely press releases and updates on upcoming ESC events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Membership/accreditation is the route by which journalists receive timely press releases and event updates; implies verification of journalistic status is required (link provided on site).

rubrics_metrics.name: Early access to embargoed content
rubrics_metrics.description: Early access to embargoed content to support your coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accredited members may be granted early access to materials under embargo to enable accurate, timely reporting; access is subject to ESC embargo policy and registration/accreditation rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requesting complimentary congress access
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunities to request complimentary access for our congresses and meetings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press representatives can request complimentary attendance passes for ESC congresses/meetings; requests are handled via the press hub and likely require accreditation/registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press releases and ESC Statements content focus
rubrics_metrics.description: The latest updates in cardiovascular science and public health issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ESC press releases and statements provide independent and trustworthy information focused on cardiovascular science and public health; use these as primary authoritative sources for related reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press resources availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to ESC journals, congress presentations and data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The press hub offers resources such as journal content, presentation materials, and data to support reporting; availability may depend on accreditation and/or embargo restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media accreditation & Registration requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: For free access to our events and embargoed content (Media accreditation & Registration).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accreditation and registration are required steps to obtain complimentary access and view embargoed materials; follow the provided procedures to apply or register.

rubrics_metrics.name: Congress coverage eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to congresses is complimentary for accredited and registered press representatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only individuals who are both accredited and registered as press representatives are eligible for complimentary congress access; organizers may enforce verification and limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact and expert comment requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether you're looking for independent expert comments, peer reviewed cardiovascular health data or information about our organisation, we're here to help!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalists are encouraged to contact ESC press contacts to request expert commentary, peer-reviewed data, or organisational information to support accurate reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: ESC Media and Embargo Policy governance
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines and Regulations for Media Outlets and Press Representatives (ESC Media and Embargo Policy).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ESC has a formal media and embargo policy that governs how embargoed information, press access, and media interactions are managed; reporters must follow these rules when using early-release materials or attending events.
